frozen: 2026-07-28 — Hermes partition ruling (NAV_SURFACE / REGISTRY / DOCTRINE / CORPUS), fragment-granular. Frozen BEFORE any subject runs; hash recorded in every episode record. Classification is by the file a tool READ, never by the expect path.

source_kinds.arm_output: The result was produced BY a nav arm under test (tool_a..tool_d). NOT a partition class — a transport annotation. Outcome FIND stands on its own; it is never re-classified through the partition.
source_kinds.file_read: The result names the file it was read from (tool_e grep hits, or any executor result line that carries a source file). EVERY file_read fragment is classified into exactly one of the four partition classes below.

NAV_SURFACE.reason: artifacts built to route — using the repo's own index IS navigation (Athena Q1 precedent)

REGISTRY.reason: backend of an arm under test or an index artifact — mining it by hand is performing the tool's job (28/40 literal-measure, Orion)
REGISTRY.judgement_notes: id-map.json is tool_a's backend (arm backend = REGISTRY by mechanism). knowledge-graph classed REGISTRY not NAV_SURFACE: Hermes ruled 'browsed as structure' only, and a grep hit IS a path dump. skills/domain-index.json carried as belt subclass (~1/40 hits, borderline).

DOCTRINE.reason: policy prose that is also the injected packet — grepping it is mining the prompt off disk, never FIND credit

CORPUS.reason: everything else — ordinary code and prose

r2_rule: Discovery requires the expect path to appear in tool OUTPUT. An appearance only in the subject's own call arguments is not discovery (Atlas R2 hole, closed).
